```cypher
MATCH (stack:Plugin {component: 'qtype_stack'})-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(dependency:Plugin)
WHERE dependency.last_release_ts < (apoc.date.parse('2026-09-10', 's', 'yyyy-MM-dd') - (3 * 365 * 24 * 60 * 60))
RETURN
    stack.component AS plugin_dependiente,
    dependency.component AS dependencia,
    dependency.name AS nombre_dependencia,
    apoc.date.format(dependency.last_release_ts, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS ultima_version_dependencia
ORDER BY ultima_version_dependencia ASC
LIMIT 100
```
